name: demo-data-seeder
description: A general Salesforce data-testing app (pure TS engine + Vite/React SPA + Fastify): point at any org, introspect its capabilities, and generate realistic, grounded test data by blending deterministic, probabilistic, and novel-LLM generation. Target schemas are pluggable packs (salescloud is the pack). See docs/app-architecture.md.

scripts.smoke: node bin/run-op.js list && node bin/run-op.js run example --companies 3
